meta.description: Registry for residue-related failure modes in Phase 2 of the Mono-Process Formal Law Program.

failure_modes.name: residue_divergence
failure_modes.description: Total residue grows without bound under update or transport cycles.

failure_modes.name: residue_loss
failure_modes.description: Residue is unrecoverably lost in the formal derivation or transport mapping.

failure_modes.name: residue_saturation_collapse
failure_modes.description: Residue saturation results in the collapse of the admissibility window or continuation selection.

failure_modes.name: unstable_residue_amplification
failure_modes.description: Residue increases non-linearly under recursive coupling, destabilizing the process system.

failure_modes.name: non_conservative_transport
failure_modes.description: NavT transport fails to preserve or account for the total residue measure within its domain.

failure_modes.name: residue_aliasing
failure_modes.description: Distinct residue states appear identical under the evaluated balance metrics.

failure_modes.name: residue_feedback_loop
failure_modes.description: Residue updates create an unconstrained positive feedback loop in candidate generation.

failure_modes.name: residue_balance_undefined
failure_modes.description: No formal balance condition has been defined for the target operator or law.
